words.prose: {{ar:حُورٌ}} ({{tr:ḥūrun}}) is the first content word after the hinge, and its nominative case makes the phrase stand as a compact nominal announcement rather than a simple continuation of the earlier genitive catalogue. The omitted predicate makes the listener supply existence or presence, so the ayah compresses a whole announcement into the head word and its qualifier. As a broken plural with tanwīn, {{ar:حُورٌ}} ({{tr:ḥūrun}}) presents a quality-bearing class, not one individualized figure or a previously identified group. The following {{ar:عِينٌ}} ({{tr:ʿīnun}}) locks onto it by matching case and indefiniteness, so the class is established first and then defined by eye-quality. Lexically, the local branch is the hawar image of intense white-black eye contrast, reinforced by the next word; whitening, return, dialogue, and purified-helper branches remain narrowed pressures rather than replacement senses. Those pressures still matter at the boundary: the word answers the prior desire with animate presence, restored radiance, and a background of purified companionship, while the recurring paradise formula in 44:54, 52:20, and 55:72 shows that 56:22 repeats known diction in the unusual shape of nominative independence. Its deep opening, long vowel, and liquid close also pair with the next word's cadence, making the two descriptors one acoustic unit.

words.prose: {{ar:عِينٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿīnun}}) completes the phrase as the postposed qualifier of {{ar:حُورٌ}} ({{tr:ḥūrun}}): it matches in nominative case, indefiniteness, and plural quality-form, and there is no intervening connector to make it a separate item. Construct variants expose the contrast by making the second word governed as a genitive specification, but the received concord makes it a defining adjective. Its tanwīn and broken plural pattern keep the description class-level, while the selected form is not the ordinary counted plural for eyes or a singular feminine individual but an adjective of large or beautiful eye-quality. The local sense is therefore eye-quality, especially because it reinforces the hawar contrast of the preceding word; broader root branches such as spring, direct witnessing, exact identity, and choiceness are narrowed to pressure around source, focused seeing, and determinate specification. That narrowing matters in this surah, because the same root at 56:18 already appeared in the flowing-water register, so the sequence moves from drinkable source to focused eye-quality. As the final word of the ayah, {{ar:عِينٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿīnun}}) closes the prior open selection field by making the compressed nominal beat land on perception, with the long ī and final tanwīn answering the cadence of {{ar:حُورٌ}} ({{tr:ḥūrun}}). The recurring paradise formula is recognizable in 37:48, 44:54, 52:20, and 55:72, but here the second slot closes a nominative phrase rather than merely filling a governed frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two-word nominal phrase joins the h-w-r class noun to an eye adjective from the ayn root.
baseline_models.mechanism: The h-w-r eye branch supplies intense white-dark contrast, while the ayn branch supplies width and beauty; together they make ocular visibility the phrase's defining feature.

activation_trace.role: Intense contrast within the eye supplies the class noun's visible distinction.
Wide, beautiful eyes specify the plural class by an ocular attribute.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely names an unspecified plural.
changed_reading.after: It presents a plural company distinguished by wide, beautiful eyes with sharply marked white-dark contrast.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence first sorts people into like cohorts, repeatedly names companions, singles out the brought-near, and seats that group face to face. This relocates the visually marked focus plural inside a reciprocal, ranked company.

activation_trace.role: Eye contrast remains the focus group's visible marker while context changes its social function.
Wide, beautiful eyes become organs of reciprocal presence rather than a detached visual detail.
Peers joined by shared form or action supply the cohort mechanism.
Abiding companionship makes the surrounding categories social companies.
Favored nearness supplies the assembly's rank and intimacy.
Mutual facing turns ocular beauty into possible reciprocal regard.

structural_cues: 56:7-16 moves from three cohorts to the brought-near group and ends with its members reclining face to face.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cohorting, companionship, favored nearness, and mutual facing; I infer that the focus plural participates in that assembly. The live alternative is that the phrase is only another item in the banquet inventory.

changed_reading.before: A visually described group detachable from the surrounding social arrangement.
changed_reading.after: A ranked company of peers within the brought-near assembly, encountered face to face and capable of reciprocal regard.

context_deltas.mechanism: Four ayat before the focus, the same ayn root names a flowing source. Its spring branch remains locally active when the root returns as the eye adjective, producing a hydro-ocular double exposure.

activation_trace.role: The flowing water source activates clarity and flow within the repeated root.
The focus form fixes the primary sense as wide, beautiful eyes while carrying the local spring resonance.

structural_cues: The same root occurs at 56:18 and 56:22 inside one uninterrupted provision sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root with spring and eye branches; I infer a local echo from recurrence and proximity. The materially live alternative is ordinary lexical separation with no cross-activation.

changed_reading.before: The adjective marks only eye size and beauty.
changed_reading.after: The wide eyes also carry a spring-source resonance of clarity, freshness, and flow within the banquet sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following comparison joins resemblance, pearl luster, and protective concealment. It converts bare ocular contrast into brightness whose value is preserved rather than publicly worn down.

activation_trace.role: Whiteness supplies the focus surface that the pearl comparison intensifies.
Wide-eyed beauty remains the embodied focus anchor for the comparison.
Explicit resemblance directs the pearl image back onto the focus plural.
Gleaming luster sharpens the focus phrase's white-dark visual intensity.
Protective covering makes the luster preserved and unexposed.

structural_cues: 56:23 directly follows the focus phrase as a comparison without introducing a new plural referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies resemblance, gleam, and protective concealment; I infer that concealment adds preserved integrity to the comparison. The alternative confines it to untouched surface appearance.

changed_reading.before: The phrase foregrounds eye geometry and color contrast alone.
changed_reading.after: The company bears pearl-like luster preserved under protection, so beauty acquires an image of intactness as well as brightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah makes correspondence between deed and consequence explicit. The focus company therefore functions within a morally caused outcome, not merely as an unmotivated luxury in a list.

activation_trace.role: The branch of people present supports reading the focus plural as company within the resulting scene.
Corresponding recompense supplies the causal relation between prior conduct and present outcome.
Intentional action supplies the antecedent to which the scene answers.

structural_cues: 56:24 immediately closes the focus phrase and its comparison with a deed-consequence formula.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense after intentional action; I infer that it causally frames the focus company's presence. The alternative is that the formula scopes the entire garden scene without changing this phrase specifically.

changed_reading.before: The company appears as an uncaused item in a provision list.
changed_reading.after: Their presence belongs to a morally ordered consequence answering prior intentional action.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the visual description, the scene opens an auditory channel and reduces all utterance to repeated peace. That environment activates the h-w-r dialogue branch and lets the focus company appear as speaking participants, not silent display.

activation_trace.role: Conversational exchange supplies a latent dialogic capacity to the focus noun.
People presently gathered keeps the dialogic activation personal and scene-bound.
Auditory perception shifts attention from looking to hearing within the same scene.
Spoken utterance gives the scene an explicit verbal medium.
Repeated peaceful concord determines the social function of that speech.

structural_cues: 56:25-26 excludes idle and harmful hearing, then leaves only a doubled utterance of peace.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an auditory turn, spoken peace, and a dialogue branch for h-w-r; I infer that the described company may participate in the exchange. The alternative keeps h-w-r's conversational branch inactive in this nominal form.

changed_reading.before: The company is primarily looked at.
changed_reading.after: The company can also be encountered as present interlocutors whose reciprocal speech participates in the scene's peace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The axle branch is lexically remote from the ordinary focus form, so this is surprising; it remains root-anchored and the nearby geometry of mutual facing plus circulation gives it a visible mechanism. Downstream prose should call it a spatial echo, not replace the ocular reading with an axle etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The h-w-r focus noun carries an axle branch while its ayn adjective keeps the image tied to seeing.

activation_trace.role: Rotation around an axis makes the focus noun a possible pivot in the scene's spatial organization.
Direct seeing keeps the axial image attached to an encounter among visible persons.
Mutual facing supplies a stable relational geometry.
Circulation around something supplies motion organized around a center.

changed_reading.before: The focus figures are stationary ornaments in a provision sequence.
changed_reading.after: They may function as human pivots within an ordered scene of mutual facing and circulating service.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The return-and-decrease branch is form-distant from the ordinary h-w-r reading, but it is exactly root-anchored and the opening reversal of lowering and raising followed by reclassification makes restoration a live mechanism. Render only as a possible reversal echo, not as a claim that the noun lexically means restored beings.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun's h-w-r root has a branch of return and transition from one state to another.

activation_trace.role: Return and change of state lets the focus class image restoration after reversal.
Lowering after height supplies one direction of status reversal.
Raising supplies the opposed direction and completes the reversal.
Classification into kinds gives the changed state a social embodiment.

changed_reading.before: The phrase identifies a fixed species of beautiful figures.
changed_reading.after: It may also image a restored or transformed state made visible after the surah's lowering, raising, and reclassification.

strongest_changes: Cohort, companionship, nearness, and mutual facing recast the phrase as reciprocal company within a ranked assembly.
The immediate hidden-pearl comparison turns ocular contrast into protected, intact luster.
The same-root spring recurrence and the later peaceful speech open hydro-ocular and dialogic readings beyond static visual beauty.
summary.what_was_special: The compact phrase became a hinge between seeing, social presence, protected luminosity, moral consequence, and speech; the strongest surprise was that nearby context repeatedly moved the figures from objects of sight toward reciprocal participants.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the same-root spring occurrence at 56:18 is an active local echo or ordinary lexical separation.
Whether the h-w-r dialogue, axle, and return branches remain live in this nominal form or are too form-distant.
Whether the recompense formula scopes the focus phrase specifically or only the entire surrounding scene.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Contrasting eyes that return the face-to-face gaze.** `ح و ر` **B001** supplies contrasting whiteness and blackness of the eye; `ع ي ن` **B016** supplies wide beautiful eyes and **B002** seeing face to face. The mutual facing of 56:16 activates a reciprocal visual relation. **Abductive move:** I infer that eye-description participates in the scene’s geometry of unobstructed encounter. **Reading change:** the phrase is not only static beauty but a capacity for mutual seeing.

2. **Purified helpers within the circulating service world.** `ح و ر` **B003** supplies a white-clad or purified helper, while `ع ي ن` **B017** allows “eye” as a person or people. **Abductive move:** I infer a coexisting social-role reading from the nearby attendants, though the grammatical brevity leaves the relation open. **Reading change:** the phrase may identify pure, conspicuous persons integrated into the scene, not merely describe ocular features.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The purified recipients of the protected book at 56:79 strengthened the secondary `ح و ر` **B003** reading of purified persons within a controlled access-world.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Visual beauty enters the same clarified ecology as the flowing source.** `ح و ر` (B001, intense contrasting whiteness and blackness of the eye) is paired with `ع ي ن` (B016, wide beautiful eyes). Within its focus window, `ع ي ن` also names the spring in ayah 18 (B006), while ayah 23 adds protected pearl-likeness. The packet supplies a repeated root moving from water-source to seeing organ; I infer an analogy of lucid, abundant appearance, not identity between the branches. The terse phrase reads as living perceptual clarity within the provision sequence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:84–85 contrasts directed looking with failure to see the nearer agency, correcting any collapse of beautiful visual clarity into unrestricted insight and preserving the root’s distinct branches.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü geri dönmeyi çekirdek yapar; bir şeyden ya da bir şeye dönüşü, iyi durumdan kötüye veya artıştan azalışa gerilemeyi ve ileri geri gidip kararsız kalmayı açıkça kapsar. Geçici çerçeve bu bağımlı uzantıları doğru sınırlar.
